programmes.d: Brothers' greed causes them to abandon all respect for human life.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programmes.d: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.
An anonymous tip links the kidnapping of a jeweler with a bank robbery two months earlier.
Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.
In January 1984, a U.S. Customs officer disappeared from his post near the Del Rio.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programmes.d: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.
Amid the cocaine wars of 1980s Miami, a multi-agency tactical squad work to stop it.

A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.
In Richmond, Virginia, two masked men who were robbing a bank escaped.

Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.
A 74-year-old man is murdered.

When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.
Ransom and family car.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programmes.d: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.
In December 1981, a New Jersey state trooper was shot to death on the side of Interstate 80.

In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.
Authorities try to gather evidence of murder and drug trafficking by a Washington, D.C., gang.

In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.
In 2000, the FBI was overwhelmed with investigations in Seattle,

The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.
A bank vault was blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables was missing.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programmes.d: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.
After an Arkansas state trooper is shot and killed, officers catch the murderer.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programmes.d: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
In 1992, a Washington, DC professor was shot and killed as she tried to get into her car.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programmes.d: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.
Cuban detainees in Atlanta revolt in response to their impending deportation.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programmes.d: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.
A nocturnal killer preys on senior citizens in 1997 Louisiana.
In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.
In 1996, a series of bank robberies in Texas baffled authorities.
Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.
Two masked bandits rob armored-car couriers at Las Vegas casinos.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programmes.d: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.
In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home.
In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.
Investigative techniques.
In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.
Croatians seek to secure Croatia's sovereignty via terrorism.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programmes.d: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.
In 1994, men dressed as police officers commit a plague of home robberies in Detroit.
Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.
The FBI captures five terrorists who tried to hijack a Royal Jordanian flight in 1985.
For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.
The Cuban nationalist group Omega 7 takes credit for a murder.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programmes.d: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.
The investigation of a New York City bombing that cost a young officer his eye.
